name: A correction given once is followed afterwards
purpose: A correction given once is followed afterwards.
record: Twelve written cases (evaluation/feedback_learning/build_cases.py): six corrections that name a record, a field and a new value for a spec, a metric or a quality profile, two that name the person so the edit is scoped to them, and four too vague to turn into an edit, which must come back unresolved. One number: the share of cases whose result equals the expected edit or reason. Real corrections from people are not in this set; whether a correction is then followed in later answers is measured by ESOI Application on the edit and by the Response Quality metrics on the answers.
disadvantages: The cases are written, not replayed from real feedback.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arm and its rival were recorded on the same cases]
command: esoi run feedback_learning --impl scoped_record_edit; esoi run feedback_learning --impl kept_note
